title: Invoice Aging Bucket Report
description:
Categorize all unpaid invoices (past due as of **2024-06-01**) into aging buckets based on days overdue: `'0-30'`, `'31-60'`, `'61-90'`, and `'90+'`. Return the count and total amount per bucket.

**Table: invoices** — `invoice_id`, `customer_name`, `amount`, `due_date`

Output columns: `aging_bucket`, `invoice_count`, `total_amount`. Order by `MIN(days_overdue)` ascending.
solution_sql: WITH overdue AS (SELECT invoice_id, customer_name, amount, due_date, ('2024-06-01'::DATE - due_date) AS days_overdue FROM invoices WHERE due_date < '2024-06-01'::DATE) SELECT CASE WHEN days_overdue <= 30 THEN '0-30' WHEN days_overdue <= 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN days_overdue <= 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END AS aging_bucket, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM overdue GROUP BY CASE WHEN days_overdue <= 30 THEN '0-30' WHEN days_overdue <= 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN days_overdue <= 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END ORDER BY MIN(days_overdue);

test_cases.description: 0-30: 3 invoices (ACME=12d, Kappa=22d, Iota=7d); 31-60: 2 (Beta=31d, Gamma=42d); 61-90: 2 (Delta=61d, Epsilon=73d); 90+: 3 (Zeta=92d, Eta=137d, Theta=182d)

hints: Calculate days_overdue = '2024-06-01'::DATE - due_date (INTEGER in DuckDB) in a CTE; filter for due_date < '2024-06-01'.
Use CASE WHEN to assign buckets, then GROUP BY the same CASE expression.
ORDER BY MIN(days_overdue) within each bucket produces chronological bucket ordering.
explanation: 10 invoices all have due_date before 2024-06-01. Days overdue: Iota=7, ACME=12, Kappa=22, Beta=31, Gamma=42, Delta=61, Epsilon=73, Zeta=92, Eta=137, Theta=182. Buckets: '0-30'={Iota,ACME,Kappa}=3 invoices/$1400. '31-60'={Beta,Gamma}=2/$1750. '61-90'={Delta,Epsilon}=2/$2300. '90+'={Zeta,Eta,Theta}=3/$4800.
